_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process that owns the subprocesses
_schema.SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - subprocess whose action items are searched
_schema.SIBLING_SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - subprocess outside the searched subtree, used when the process has no action item entity
_schema.UNKNOWN_PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process name that does not exist
_schema.UNKNOWN_SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - subprocess name that does not exist
_schema.ATTRIBUTE_FILTER: object (required) - PSR 'Action Items Attribute Search - Subprocess' filter (code lists)
_schema.PO_INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - PO errorCode for a hierarchy retrieval error
_schema.CHILD_SUBPROCESS: object (required) - create body for the temporary child subprocess; name, reference and parent are set at runtime
_schema.CHILD_SUBPROCESS_DELETE_ALLOWED: object (required) - whether the machine client may delete subprocesses, keyed by GATEWAY_TYPE; AI-09-P03 is skipped when false
_schema.PROCESS_ACTION_ITEM: object (required) - create body for a process action item; name, entityId, sourceId and origin are set at runtime
_schema.SUBPROCESS_ACTION_ITEM: object (required) - create body for a subprocess action item; name and entityId are set at runtime
